Subject: Exec intro — can we get your CTO on the 4th?

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency numbers and the rollout examples. Our CTO, Aaron Blake, asked to be part of a brief executive intro next week to discuss architecture fit and compliance patterns. Would your team be available for a 35-minute call on Tue May 4th between 10:00–13:00 PT? Aaron is available in the 10:30–11:30 slot.

I've attached a short agenda (Ardent_ExecAgenda_v1.pdf) and tentative attendee list. If the CTO can't do the proposed time, he's open to swapping to 14:00–15:00 PT but prefers morning.

Proposed attendees: Aaron Blake (CTO), Lydia Chen (GTM), Hannah (Redwood lead), Kar (technical lead)

Would you mind confirming whether your VP or CTO-level sponsor can join? If not, we can proceed with your director-level lead.

Best,
Lydia

I'll follow up internally and confirm whether our VP of Product can join; if not, we'll bring in our Head of Platform (Jonas) as backup.
